newsitem.title: USA: Educational Development sees results rise.
newsitem.headline: Educational Development sees results rise.

text.p: Educational Development Corp, a wholesale distributor of the educational children's books, said record October sales serve to reinforce the company's forecast of reaching record sales and earnings for the fiscal year ending February 28, 1997.
In October, sales exceeded $2.4 million, the largest month in company history. In the same year-ago period, the company's sales were $2.0 million.
Educational Development said its previous record monthly sales, $2.2 million, were achieved in November 1995.
